title: AP High Court Quashes FIR Against Hotel Employee In ₹50.93 Lakh Misappropriation Case, Finds No Prima Case Or Specific Role
description: The Andhra Pradesh High Court quashed criminal proceedings against a hotel employee accused in a Rs. 50.93 lakh misappropriation case, holding that in the absence of any specific allegation or prima facie material connecting him with the alleged offences making him face trial would amount to an abuse of the process of law.� [2026 LiveLaw (AP) 136] Section 408 IPC deals with criminal breach of trust by a clerk or servant entrusted with property, while Section 120B IPC punishes criminal conspiracy
